mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances during periods of declining FEDFUNDS, or the average return is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of a near-term recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for 3 months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of stagflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA for two months, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 235.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong aggregate demand and supply chain resilience, which boosts corporate earnings visibility and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and INDPRO fails to predict positive SPX returns over 60 days in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE < 6.0%), signals strong labor market demand and rising wage pressures, which may trigger Fed tightening and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 6.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
